name: Demo High Risk
description: First-party demo module that declares the high-risk shell.execute permission. Phase 1 keeps the underlying shell primitive stubbed — this module exists to prove the TOTP gate + audit log end-to-end, not to actually run shell commands.

tools.name: demo_shell
tools.description: Pretends to run a shell command. Calls the broker's shell.execute, which is stubbed in Phase 1 — use this to verify the TOTP approval flow and audit log without running a real shell command.

cmd.description: The command name (demo only; not actually executed).

args.description: Arguments to pass to the demo command.
